method: 48 frames at configured 640x360 Eevee settings; poll UI API, power off GPU3 with a running frame after its first completed frame; verify process exit, shared PNG hash, original retry deadline and MP4 stsz sample counts. Separate new run: restart origin during rendering, explicitly resume durable session.
limitations: Local process-manifest fencing and shared laptop storage; not remote outage recovery.
One physical Iris Xe GPU, three logical workers.
Heat values use the documented synthetic 0.8 kWh per frame-hour assumption, not measured electrical/thermal energy.
Timing is one observation per scenario, not a controlled speed comparison.
